display.title: Children, the Guarantors of the Torah
display.summary_short: Children are the heroes of Shavuos: Hashem gave the Torah only after Moshe offered the young children learning the Aleph-Beis as guarantors.
display.summary_long: A Shavuos talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi reminds children that they were the center of attention on Pesach, asking the Four Questions and hiding the afikoman, and that on Shavuos too they play the most important role. Before giving the Torah, Hashem asked Moshe Rabbeinu what guarantee there was that the Jewish people would keep learning it for all generations. Moshe offered the great scholars who learn day and night, but Hashem said that was not enough. He offered the young scholars in the yeshivos, and again Hashem said no. Finally Moshe asked Hashem to listen to the pure voices of small children calling out the holy letters of the Aleph-Beis, and Hashem agreed: as long as young children learn Torah, it will be studied forever. So children are the heroes of the day, and before Shavuos they should resolve to learn more Torah than ever, receiving it with joy and inwardly, as the Rebbe says.
display.lesson: The Torah was given in the merit of children who learn it, so resolve to learn more Torah than ever.
